prompt: I've got 3 technical PDFs with different layouts - one has a scanned financial report, another has a scientific paper with complex tables, and the third has an engineering diagram with annotations. I need you to: 1) Extract all the tables from these PDFs and convert them to Excel format with proper column headers, 2) Extract all text annotations and their coordinates, 3) Create a summary report PDF that shows statistics about each document (page count, table count, annotation count, word count) along with thumbnail images of the first page of each document. The summary should be nicely formatted with a professional layout.
